note: Plugin trees of the hit-check are NOT redistributed (most have no permissive LICENSE file). Batch B entries carry exact commits (pre = parent, post = fix commit). Batch A trees were taken from the HEAD of shallow clones at sweep time and no commit was recorded: fetch_plugins.py fetches the current HEAD, so line numbers may have moved. license_file_in_package is the licence family of a LICENSE file found in the original tree (null = none found).
